item.title: YASA beats own power density record pushing electric motor to 59kW/kg benchmark
item.description:
📝 Hitting a staggering 750kW (>1000bhp) short-term peak rating, YASA has set a new unofficial electric motor power density world record of 59kW/kg – a 40% increase on initial testing. This motor will bring game-changing technology to the high-performance automotive sector. ” “This record demonstrates what makes YASA unique,” added Joerg Miska, CEO, YASA.
🔗 Read more: https://yasa.com/news/yasa-smashes-own-unofficial-power-density-world-record-pushing-state-of-the-art-electric-motor-to-staggering-new-59kw-kg-benchmark/
